$schema: Instance config for an ai-bridge control panel. Customize, then commit.
$people: EXAMPLE ONLY -- replace both entries below with your team's real GitHub login -> commit email pairs, HERE in this instance. The ai-setup template is public, so it ships placeholder logins VERIFIED UNCLAIMED on github.com (example-user-007/008 both 404) and addresses at example.com, which RFC 2606 reserves and which cannot receive mail. If you write a new example, verify the login is unclaimed the same way: a plausible name like alice or bob is a real account, and an example naming a stranger is an example someone copies. The address is PER-INSTANCE, not per-person: the same login belongs to a different address in each group's bundle, because the address says which entity the work belongs to -- so never derive it from the login, and never move it into instance.config.local.json (that file says which login this clone IS). Used by scripts/commit-as.sh so each clone authors commits as the human running it; see SCHEMA.md 'Per-machine config overrides'. (A future install.sh may offer to ask for these when stamping a new instance.)
